rationale.text: No element of the page carries lang or xml:lang, so the page has no default language, which the glossary places on the html element or on each element of the page. The test applies to each page having a default language, so it does not apply here (the missing indication is a matter for 8.3.1). The entry's applicability is judgment and its level is below full, so the tool never says not applicable: the custom check answers cannot_tell when html has no required attribute, and the finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.

citations.quote: Pour chaque page web ayant une langue par défaut, le code de langue vérifie-t-il ces conditions
Indication de la langue de traitement principale du document qui peut être présente sur l’élément racine html ou sur chaque élément de la page concerné via les attributs lang et/ou xml:lang
